validationNotes: The old-build-compatible regression fails on a genuine blank viewport, not on missing new test IDs: 55:1–55:14 mounted at 4000px; live script/translation responses each held all 78 ayahs.
The first iOS Hermes compiler was SIGKILLed on the 2GB validation machine. The unchanged source exported successfully using a 256MB Node heap in a separate sequential run.

Initial ad-hoc scrolling used scrollTo({top}) on a React Native Web ref whose imperative method expects x/y; it did not actually move and is not used as reproduction evidence. The committed regression sets the real scrollTop and captures real viewport/row geometry.
limitations: Browser checks and Hermes exports are not installed Android/iOS device tests, OEM clipping validation or device performance benchmarks. The user reported Android and browser symptoms; direct reproduction here is production web.
Complete scans cover Ar-Rahman and Al-Baqarah, with additional Urdu and large-font continuous Ar-Rahman profiles; this is not a claim that every surah/language/device was exhaustively scanned.
No manual deployment, store release, dependency, generated artwork, user-data migration/deletion, Tajweed or Mufahras change is included. A Git push alone does not update an installed Android binary.
